---
title: "Simulation Results: Summary Tables and Visualizations"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# Script Name: 03_results_summary_and_plots.Rmd
# Purpose:     Generates summary tables, bias plots, and coverage plots for 
#              both standard survival and competing risks simulation results.
# ==============================================================================

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, 
  warning = FALSE, 
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(cowplot)
library(knitr)

# Define shared visualization theme
shared_theme <- theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
```

# Part 1: Standard Survival Outcomes

```{r}
# Read the standard survival simulation data
results_std <- read.csv("results/combined_results_standard.csv")

# Calculate Mean Bias and Empirical Standard Error (SE)
summary_table_std <- results_std %>%
  group_by(scenario, target_cens_pct, threshold) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_bias_km     = mean(bias_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bias_cox    = mean(bias_ipcw_cox, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bias_miscox = mean(bias_ipcw_miscox, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    se_km     = sd(NB_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_cox    = sd(NB_ipcw_cox, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_miscox = sd(NB_ipcw_miscox, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Format scenario descriptions for presentation
    Scenario = case_when(
      scenario == "non_informative_cox" ~ "Non-informative",
      scenario == "informative_simple_cox" ~ "Informative",
      TRUE ~ scenario
    ),
    Censoring = paste0(target_cens_pct * 100, "%"),
    Threshold = paste0(threshold * 100, "%"),
    
    # Format metrics as "Mean Bias (SE)"
    `KM`                       = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean_bias_km, se_km),
    `CIPCW (Cox)`              = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean_bias_cox, se_cox),
    `CIPCW (Misspecified Cox)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean_bias_miscox, se_miscox)
  ) %>%
  # Filter to the primary scenarios of interest
  filter(Scenario %in% c("Non-informative", "Informative")) %>%
  select(Scenario, Censoring, Threshold, `KM`, `CIPCW (Cox)`, `CIPCW (Misspecified Cox)`)

# Print the formatted table
kable(summary_table_std, caption = "Standard Survival: Mean Bias (Empirical SE)")
```


```{r}
# Prepare data for bias visualization
data_bias_std <- results_std %>%
  mutate(
    Scenario = case_when(
      scenario == "non_informative_cox" ~ "Non-informative",
      scenario == "informative_simple_cox" ~ "Informative",
      TRUE ~ scenario
    ),
    Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = c("Non-informative", "Informative")),
    Censoring = paste0(target_cens_pct * 100, "% Censoring"),
    Threshold = factor(paste0(threshold * 100, "%"), levels = paste0(sort(unique(threshold)) * 100, "%"))
  ) %>%
  filter(Scenario %in% c("Non-informative", "Informative")) %>%
  select(Scenario, Censoring, Threshold, NB_true, NB_km, NB_ipcw_cox, NB_ipcw_miscox) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(NB_km, NB_ipcw_cox, NB_ipcw_miscox), 
    names_to = "Method_Internal",
    values_to = "Estimated_NB"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric_Value = Estimated_NB - NB_true, 
    Method = case_when(
      Method_Internal == "NB_km" ~ "KM",
      Method_Internal == "NB_ipcw_cox" ~ "CIPCW (Cox)",
      Method_Internal == "NB_ipcw_miscox" ~ "CIPCW (Misspecified Cox)"
    ),
    Method = factor(Method, levels = c("KM", "CIPCW (Cox)", "CIPCW (Misspecified Cox)"))
  )

# Define color palette for standard survival estimators
colors_std <- c(
  "KM" = "#7570b3",                       
  "CIPCW (Cox)" = "#d95f02",              
  "CIPCW (Misspecified Cox)" = "#e7298a"  
)

# Generate Bias Boxplot
ggplot(data_bias_std, aes(x = Threshold, y = Metric_Value, fill = Method, color = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.5, width = 0.7, 
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  facet_grid(Censoring ~ Scenario) +
  labs(y = "Estimated NB - True NB", x = "Decision threshold") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_std) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_std) +
  shared_theme
```


```{r}
# Prepare data for empirical coverage mapping
data_cov_std <- results_std %>%
  group_by(scenario, target_cens_pct, threshold) %>%
  summarise(
    coverage_km     = mean(as.logical(cover_km), na.rm = TRUE),
    coverage_ipcw   = mean(as.logical(cover_ipcw_cox), na.rm = TRUE),
    coverage_miscox = mean(as.logical(cover_ipcw_miscox), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Scenario = case_when(
      scenario == "non_informative_cox" ~ "Non-informative",
      scenario == "informative_simple_cox" ~ "Informative",
      TRUE ~ scenario
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(Scenario %in% c("Non-informative", "Informative")) %>%
  mutate(
    Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = c("Non-informative", "Informative")),
    Censoring = paste0(target_cens_pct * 100, "% Censoring"),
    Threshold = factor(paste0(threshold * 100, "%"), levels = paste0(sort(unique(threshold)) * 100, "%"))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(coverage_km, coverage_ipcw, coverage_miscox),
    names_to = "Method_Internal",
    values_to = "Coverage"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = case_when(
      Method_Internal == "coverage_km" ~ "KM",
      Method_Internal == "coverage_ipcw" ~ "CIPCW (Cox)",
      Method_Internal == "coverage_miscox" ~ "CIPCW (Misspecified Cox)"
    ),
    Method = factor(Method, levels = c("KM", "CIPCW (Cox)", "CIPCW (Misspecified Cox)"))
  )

# Define line types
linetypes_std <- c(
  "KM" = "solid",
  "CIPCW (Cox)" = "dashed",
  "CIPCW (Misspecified Cox)" = "dotted"
)

# Generate Coverage Plot
ggplot(data_cov_std, aes(x = Threshold, y = Coverage, color = Method, group = Method, linetype = Method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.90, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, shape = 16) +
  facet_grid(Censoring ~ Scenario) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_std) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = linetypes_std) +
  labs(
    y = "Empirical coverage\n(90% uncertainty intervals)",
    x = "Decision threshold"
  ) +
  shared_theme
```

#Part 2: Competing Risks Outcomes

```{r}
# Read the competing risks simulation data
results_cr <- read.csv("results/combined_results_competing.csv")

# Calculate Mean Bias and Empirical Standard Error (SE) for competing risks
summary_table_cr <- results_cr %>%
  group_by(scenario, target_cens_pct, threshold) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_bias_aj     = mean(bias_aj, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bias_cox    = mean(bias_ipcw_cox, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bias_miscox = mean(bias_ipcw_miscox, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    se_aj     = sd(NB_aj, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_cox    = sd(NB_ipcw_cox, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_miscox = sd(NB_ipcw_miscox, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Scenario = case_when(
      scenario == "non_informative_cox" ~ "Non-informative",
      scenario == "informative_simple_cox" ~ "Informative",
      TRUE ~ scenario
    ),
    Censoring = paste0(target_cens_pct * 100, "%"),
    Threshold = paste0(threshold * 100, "%"),
    
    `AJ`                       = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean_bias_aj, se_aj),
    `CIPCW (Cox)`              = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean_bias_cox, se_cox),
    `CIPCW (Misspecified Cox)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean_bias_miscox, se_miscox)
  ) %>%
  filter(Scenario %in% c("Non-informative", "Informative")) %>%
  select(Scenario, Censoring, Threshold, `AJ`, `CIPCW (Cox)`, `CIPCW (Misspecified Cox)`)

# Print the formatted table
kable(summary_table_cr, caption = "Competing Risks: Mean Bias (Empirical SE)")
```
